technical.summary: Mixed momentum signals with short-term bullish technicals (RSI rising, MACD 8/21 crossover, volume spike) offset by intermediate/long-term weakness (price below 50/200 MAs, below cloud, overbought oscillators) and neutral sector backdrop.

fundamental.summary: VTR shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 97 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money conviction to support a trade.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (277.6) indicates extreme market stress, NFP event today adds binary risk, and real estate sector faces credit stress in tightening environment.
